name: Annbriar Golf Course
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Hickory, Black. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

9: Black tee (CHECK) sits on a lidar pad in the tree line ~36 yds east of the hole-9 tee complex (31 yds from any OSM tee), so the Black line runs along the right-hand trees and the pick is 2-wood aimed 40 right.
